# CALIBRATION AND TEST CERTIFICATE

**Generated by:** `records/make_records.py`   **Source record:** `<unit_serial>_test.json`

This is a TEMPLATE. Every `{{...}}` is filled from the per-unit record and from nowhere
else; the field paths beside them are JSON pointers into that record, so the certificate and
the record cannot disagree. One printed A4 page per unit. It travels in the case lid wallet
beside the quick-start card (PKG-EEG-015 Rev B section 1.1 line 6.5).

## 5. Verification

| Step | What it verifies | Measured | Limit | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T3 | Power-on current and DevKit regulator temperature | `{{results.T3.data}}` | Idle < 90 mA; recording at 1000 Hz < 150 mA; rails within 3 %; regulator case temperature < 85 degC | `{{results.T3.verdict}}` |
| T7 | Front-end gain | `{{results.T7.data}}` | Matching between the eight EEG channels within 0.5 % after calibration, at the 100 uV and 1 mV points only. The 10 uV point is a linearity check with a +/- 5 % limit | `{{results.T7.verdict}}` |
| T8 | Noise floor | `{{results.T8.data}}` | <= 1.0 uV RMS on each EEG channel; pass on the median epoch. Calculated expectation 0.27 uV RMS with the 47 kOhm fitted | `{{results.T8.verdict}}` |
| T9 | Crosstalk and CMRR | `{{results.T9.data}}` | Crosstalk < -80 dB, measured on the carrier; CMRR >= 100 dB -- a provisional limit that TST-EEG-004 sets and no requirement carries (section 16 item 15) | `{{results.T9.verdict}}` |
| T10 | Lead-off calibration | `{{results.T10.data}}` | R_off within the fitted series-resistor value +/- 5 %, and after correction each of the three reference points reported within 15 % | `{{results.T10.verdict}}` |
| T12 | Envelope channels | `{{results.T12.data}}` | Scaling within +/- 5 % of 100 mV at the converter input. Group-delay spread <= 2 samples. Comparator trips between 45 and 60 mV. T12d AC corner <= 2 Hz. T12e f0 between 42 and 58 Hz | `{{results.T12.verdict}}` |
| T13 | Timing self-test | `{{results.T13.data}}` | Median <= 1 sample, 95th percentile <= 2 samples | `{{results.T13.verdict}}` |
| T14 | microSD throughput and integrity | `{{results.T14.data}}` | Zero missing sequence numbers, and the card copy identical to the host copy | `{{results.T14.verdict}}` |
| T17 | Buttons, mute, headphone level | `{{results.T17.data}}` | 30 of 30 presses produce exactly one event; mute attenuation >= 60 dB; headphone level within 1 dB of target with THD <= 0.1 %; clamp register value equal to the T28 lot value | `{{results.T17.verdict}}` |
| T20 | Isolation-barrier insulation resistance | `{{results.T20.data}}` | >= 1 GOhm. Where the module carries a cross-barrier Y-capacitor the limit is the value recorded for that module type at T00 | `{{results.T20.verdict}}` |
| T21 | VBUS detection and charge-path interlock | `{{results.T21.data}}` | Junction voltage 2.85 to 3.15 V; session start refused with the defined ACK code; CHG_CE asserted throughout; state clears within one STATUS frame | `{{results.T21.verdict}}` |
| T22 | Frequency response | `{{results.T22.data}}` | E-10 has two states and the record must say which one was applied: +/- 0.5 dB with the 47 kOhm fitted, widening to +/- 1.0 dB only if ECO-EEG-024 raises R1 to R16 to 68 kOhm | `{{results.T22.verdict}}` |
| T23 | Leakage current at the applied parts | `{{results.T23.data}}` | Normal condition <= 10 uA DC and <= 100 uA AC; single fault <= 50 uA DC | `{{results.T23.verdict}}` |

Section 13 item 5 names T7a matching, T9a, T9b and T12b explicitly; T7, T9 and T12 are one step each in the section 2 list, so their sub-step values sit inside the one object named above. The limits are quoted from the record rather than retyped, because the record carries them verbatim from section 8.

## 7. Statement of limitations

Printed in full, not summarised. TST-EEG-004 Rev C section 13 item 7 requires all of it.

- This certificate is **not** a medical-device conformity statement.
- T23 is a stand-in for the IEC 60601-1 patient auxiliary current measurement, and
  **S-02 is not met at the fitted resistor value**.
- The 2.5 kV isolation figure is a component supplier's certificate and was **not verified
  on this unit**.
- The 45 degC charge inhibit is **not implemented**: there is no NTC net and no thermistor
  way, so S-04's thermistor-monitored charging is not met.
- **No safety engineer has reviewed this design as of the date of issue.**
